evals.prompt: Review a per-node GovVote SeiNodeTask: it soft-name-refs one SeiNode via spec.target.nodeRef.name, encodes proposalId as the JSON string "142", sets option VOTE_OPTION_YES, uses keyName node_admin, and is one of N manifests fanned across the validators per /gov-ops's fan-out template. The flow verifies the vote by querying the chain.
expected_behavior: Loads sei-validator-profile.md + kit-seinodetask-gov-manifests.md before judging (Guardrail 1)

Concludes it conforms — cites the per-node fan-out (no selector), camelCase + integer-as-JSON-string encoding, node_admin via the keyring ladder, and chain-based verification as correct against the profile
Notes GovVote is chain-idempotent (last-write-wins) so re-apply is safe; defers the fan-out template + fee floor to /gov-ops rather than restating them; does not manufacture findings

evals.prompt: An operator asks whether they can safely re-apply each of the three gov SeiNodeTask kinds — GovVote, GovSoftwareUpgrade, GovParamChange — to recover after the sidecar crashed mid-task.
expected_behavior: Reasons per-kind: GovVote is chain-idempotent (last-write-wins on proposalId/voter) → re-apply safe; GovSoftwareUpgrade and GovParamChange are NOT idempotent (crash-window double-broadcast), both covered by the open seictl#174, GovParamChange higher-blast-radius (profile §5)
States the rule: submit-once; a re-apply re-joins the existing run via the task-ID (UUIDv5) and is the correct recovery — never a delete-recreate
Cites §controller (task-ID, CRD idempotency comments) + §seictl (gov_*.go REHYDRATION WARNING headers, seictl#174); does not restate a /gov-ops gate

evals.prompt: A GovParamChange task is stuck and the operator says 'just kubectl delete the SeiNodeTask and re-apply it to retry the submit'.
expected_behavior: Refuses the delete-recreate: it mints a NEW run (new task-ID) → a duplicate proposal + deposit on a non-idempotent kind; GovParamChange is the higher-blast-radius case (Guardrail 3, profile §5)
Offers the correct recovery: re-apply the same manifest to re-join the existing run via its task-ID (UUIDv5), or read the chain to confirm whether the original already broadcast (taskID= memo)
Routes the gated retry through /gov-ops; does not assert the broadcast as the fix

evals.prompt: A PR adds a GovParamChange SeiNodeTask whose payload sets `height: 12750000` as a bare JSON number, uses snake_case `proposal_id`, and supplies the struct param `value` as an escaped JSON string "{\"key\":...}".
expected_behavior: Flags integer-as-JSON-number: height (and any string-typed integer like proposalId) must be quoted — "12750000" (Dimension 1 (Manifest correctness & encoding))
Flags the double-encode trap: a struct param value must be a JSON OBJECT, not an escaped JSON string (Dimension 1)
Flags snake_case: fields are camelCase; cites §controller (CRD payload) + §seictl (handler deserialization); does not restate the /gov-ops value-shape gate but may cite it
evals.source: kit-seinodetask-gov-manifests §2/§3; method Dimension 1; profile encoding rules

evals.prompt: An operator wants to fan an arctic-1 GovSoftwareUpgrade across validators on the prod / eu-central-1 kube-context, which co-hosts pacific-1 mainnet. They ask this skill to define the safety rule that blocks a wrong-chain submit.
expected_behavior: Defers to /gov-ops: the mainnet-adjacency allowlist + co-host refuse is /gov-ops's, a shipped anchor-coupled skill — points at it, does NOT restate a weaker prod-pattern rule (Guardrail 5, profile §8)

Notes the chain-ID confusion guard (guardChainID, sign_and_broadcast.go:316: chainId == SEI_CHAIN_ID env AND node /status node_info.network) as the in-seictl backstop, cited to §seictl — but the operator-level gate is /gov-ops's
Does not author a local allowlist or assert the submit as safe

evals.prompt: After applying a GovSoftwareUpgrade SeiNodeTask the operator's script polls `status.outputs.proposalId` to get the proposal id and reports it as empty/missing.
expected_behavior: Explains status.outputs is UNPOPULATED for sidecar gov kinds and proposalId is not returned — this is expected, not a failure (Dimension 4 (Result verification), profile §6)
Rewrite: read the CHAIN — correlate via the taskID= memo, query the proposal/txHash on-chain (seid query gov vocabulary, §sei-skill)
Names the structural RPC pin (one sidecar ↔ one co-located node, verify/broadcast TOCTOU closed by construction); cites §controller

evals.prompt: A gentx-bootstrapped validator has no operatorKeyring secret set; a manifest assumes keyName node_admin will sign. The operator cites the seinode-task LLD for the signing topology.
expected_behavior: Walks the ladder: explicit → node_admin (if operatorKeyring secret set) → validator gentx key (if unset) — with no secret set it falls through to the validator gentx key, so assuming node_admin signs with the wrong key (profile §4)

Cites the ladder to §controller (resolveSigningUID seinodetask_params.go:231, CRD comments, DefaultOperatorKeyName validator_types.go:7) — NOT the LLD, which is STALE on signing-topology (Guardrail 2)
Flags the footgun explicitly

evals.prompt: Asked '/validator-platform check my gov submit is right' with no manifest, no nodeRef, and no on-chain state in scope.
expected_behavior: Halts and asks for the manifest / nodeRef / on-chain state; never reasons about a gov submit from memory (Halt conditions)
Does not fabricate findings about an unseen manifest

evals.prompt: While reviewing a fan-out the user asks this skill to spell out the exact fee floor number, hard-code the GovVote fan-out template, and write the mainnet-adjacency allowlist inline so it's self-contained.
expected_behavior: Refuses to restate: the fee-floor numbers, the GovVote fan-out template (fan-out.md), and the mainnet-adjacency allowlist are /gov-ops's — a shipped anchor-coupled skill left unchanged; this skill CITES them at the seam (Guardrail 2, Dimension 5 (Citation discipline))
Points at /gov-ops for those; keeps to the net-new K8s/sidecar/operator machinery it owns
Confirms /gov-ops keeps its existing seinode-task anchor citations as-is — does not re-point it through this skill
